WITH ingredients AS (
  SELECT 1307863 AS concept_id, 'non-DHP' AS ccb_class, 'verapamil' AS ingredient UNION ALL
  SELECT 1328165, 'non-DHP', 'diltiazem' UNION ALL
  SELECT 1332418, 'DHP', 'amlodipine' UNION ALL
  SELECT 1318853, 'DHP', 'nifedipine' UNION ALL
  SELECT 1353776, 'DHP', 'felodipine' UNION ALL
  SELECT 1326012, 'DHP', 'isradipine' UNION ALL
  SELECT 1318137, 'DHP', 'nicardipine' UNION ALL
  SELECT 1319880, 'DHP', 'nisoldipine' UNION ALL
  SELECT 1319133, 'DHP', 'nimodipine' UNION ALL
  SELECT 19089969, 'DHP', 'clevidipine'
)
SELECT i.ccb_class, i.ingredient, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id) AS descendant_drug_concepts
FROM ingredients i
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = i.concept_id
JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id AND c.domain_id='Drug'
GROUP BY i.ccb_class, i.ingredient
ORDER BY i.ccb_class DESC, i.ingredient

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id) AS bradycardia_descendant_condition_concepts
FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 4169095 AND c.domain_id='Condition' AND ISNULL(c.standard_concept,'')='S'

arguments.sql_query:
WITH ingredients AS (
  SELECT 1307863 AS ingredient_concept_id, 'non-DHP' AS ccb_class UNION ALL
  SELECT 1328165, 'non-DHP' UNION ALL
  SELECT 1332418, 'DHP' UNION ALL
  SELECT 1318853, 'DHP' UNION ALL
  SELECT 1353776, 'DHP' UNION ALL
  SELECT 1326012, 'DHP' UNION ALL
  SELECT 1318137, 'DHP' UNION ALL
  SELECT 1319880, 'DHP' UNION ALL
  SELECT 1319133, 'DHP' UNION ALL
  SELECT 19089969, 'DHP'
), ccb_drugs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT i.ccb_class, ca.descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id
  FROM ingredients i
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = i.ingredient_concept_id
), index_exposure AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, cd.ccb_class, MIN(de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS index_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN ccb_drugs cd ON cd.drug_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  WHERE de.drug_exposure_start_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY de.person_id, cd.ccb_class
), brady_conditions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS condition_concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
  JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 4169095
    AND c.domain_id = 'Condition'
)
SELECT
  ie.ccb_class,
  COUNT(*) AS exposed_persons,
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
    JOIN brady_conditions bc ON bc.condition_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
    WHERE co.person_id = ie.person_id
      AND co.condition_start_date >= ie.index_date
      AND co.condition_start_date < DATEADD(day, 60, ie.index_date)
  ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS brady_60d_persons,
  CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
    JOIN brady_conditions bc ON bc.condition_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
    WHERE co.person_id = ie.person_id
      AND co.condition_start_date >= ie.index_date
      AND co.condition_start_date < DATEADD(day, 60, ie.index_date)
  ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS DECIMAL(10,3)) AS brady_60d_percent
FROM index_exposure ie
GROUP BY ie.ccb_class
ORDER BY ie.ccb_class DESC

WITH ingredients AS (
  SELECT 1307863 AS ingredient_concept_id, 'non-DHP' AS ccb_class UNION ALL
  SELECT 1328165, 'non-DHP' UNION ALL
  SELECT 1332418, 'DHP' UNION ALL
  SELECT 1318853, 'DHP' UNION ALL
  SELECT 1353776, 'DHP' UNION ALL
  SELECT 1326012, 'DHP' UNION ALL
  SELECT 1318137, 'DHP' UNION ALL
  SELECT 1319880, 'DHP' UNION ALL
  SELECT 1319133, 'DHP' UNION ALL
  SELECT 19089969, 'DHP'
), ccb_drugs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT i.ccb_class, ca.descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id
  FROM ingredients i
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = i.ingredient_concept_id
), index_exposure AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, cd.ccb_class, MIN(de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS index_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN ccb_drugs cd ON cd.drug_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  WHERE de.drug_exposure_start_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY de.person_id, cd.ccb_class
), brady_conditions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS condition_concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
  JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 4169095
    AND c.domain_id = 'Condition'
), flags AS (
  SELECT ie.person_id, ie.ccb_class, ie.index_date,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
      JOIN brady_conditions bc ON bc.condition_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
      WHERE co.person_id = ie.person_id
        AND co.condition_start_date >= ie.index_date
        AND co.condition_start_date < DATEADD(day, 60, ie.index_date)
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS brady_60d
  FROM index_exposure ie
)
SELECT
  ccb_class,
  COUNT(*) AS exposed_persons,
  SUM(brady_60d) AS brady_60d_persons,
  CAST(100.0 * SUM(brady_60d) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS DECIMAL(10,3)) AS brady_60d_percent
FROM flags
GROUP BY ccb_class
ORDER BY ccb_class DESC

SELECT c.concept_id, c.concept_name, COUNT(*) AS drug_era_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) AS persons
FROM omop.drug_era de
JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
WHERE de.drug_concept_id IN (1307863,1328165,1332418,1318853,1353776,1326012,1318137,1319880,1319133,19089969)
GROUP BY c.concept_id, c.concept_name
ORDER BY persons DESC

WITH index_exposure AS (
  SELECT person_id,
         CASE WHEN drug_concept_id IN (1307863,1328165) THEN 'non-DHP' ELSE 'DHP' END AS ccb_class,
         MIN(CAST(drug_era_start_date AS date)) AS index_date
  FROM omop.drug_era
  WHERE drug_concept_id IN (1307863,1328165,1332418,1318853,1353776,1326012,1318137,1319880,1319133,19089969)
  GROUP BY person_id, CASE WHEN drug_concept_id IN (1307863,1328165) THEN 'non-DHP' ELSE 'DHP' END
), brady_conditions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS condition_concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
  JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 4169095
    AND c.domain_id = 'Condition'
), brady_events AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT co.person_id, co.condition_start_date
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  JOIN brady_conditions bc ON bc.condition_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
), flags AS (
  SELECT ie.person_id, ie.ccb_class,
    MAX(CASE WHEN be.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS brady_60d
  FROM index_exposure ie
  LEFT JOIN brady_events be
    ON be.person_id = ie.person_id
   AND be.condition_start_date >= ie.index_date
   AND be.condition_start_date < DATEADD(day, 60, ie.index_date)
  GROUP BY ie.person_id, ie.ccb_class
)
SELECT ccb_class,
       COUNT(*) AS exposed_persons,
       SUM(brady_60d) AS brady_60d_persons,
       CAST(100.0 * SUM(brady_60d) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS DECIMAL(10,3)) AS brady_60d_percent
FROM flags
GROUP BY ccb_class
ORDER BY ccb_class DESC

WITH ccb_eras AS (
  SELECT person_id,
         CASE WHEN drug_concept_id IN (1307863,1328165) THEN 'non-DHP' ELSE 'DHP' END AS ccb_class,
         CAST(drug_era_start_date AS date) AS start_date
  FROM omop.drug_era
  WHERE drug_concept_id IN (1307863,1328165,1332418,1318853,1353776,1326012,1318137,1319880,1319133,19089969)
), first_date AS (
  SELECT person_id, MIN(start_date) AS index_date
  FROM ccb_eras
  GROUP BY person_id
), index_class AS (
  SELECT fd.person_id, fd.index_date,
         CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT ce.ccb_class) > 1 THEN 'mixed_same_day'
              ELSE MAX(ce.ccb_class) END AS ccb_class
  FROM first_date fd
  JOIN ccb_eras ce ON ce.person_id = fd.person_id AND ce.start_date = fd.index_date
  GROUP BY fd.person_id, fd.index_date
), brady_conditions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS condition_concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
  JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 4169095 AND c.domain_id = 'Condition'
), flags AS (
  SELECT ic.person_id, ic.ccb_class,
         MAX(CASE WHEN co.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS brady_60d
  FROM index_class ic
  LEFT JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co
    ON co.person_id = ic.person_id
   AND co.condition_start_date >= ic.index_date
   AND co.condition_start_date < DATEADD(day, 60, ic.index_date)
   AND co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT condition_concept_id FROM brady_conditions)
  GROUP BY ic.person_id, ic.ccb_class
)
SELECT ccb_class,
       COUNT(*) AS exposed_persons,
       SUM(brady_60d) AS brady_60d_persons,
       CAST(100.0 * SUM(brady_60d) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS DECIMAL(10,3)) AS brady_60d_percent
FROM flags
GROUP BY ccb_class
ORDER BY ccb_class DESC

Using OMOP `drug_era` and bradycardia descendant condition concepts under SNOMED `Bradycardia` (`concept_id=4169095`):

| Cohort definition | Exposed persons | 60-day bradycardia | Rate |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| First CCB era = non-DHP (`verapamil`, `diltiazem`) | 15,964 | 296 | **1.854%** |
| First CCB era = DHP | 111,052 | 2,543 | **2.290%** |
| Mixed same-day first exposure | 845 | 60 | 7.101% |

**Answer:** No. In this unadjusted first-exposure comparison, non-dihydropyridine CCBs did **not** have higher 60-day bradycardia coding than dihydropyridines; the observed rate was slightly lower (1.85% vs 2.29%).

Caveats: this is crude/unadjusted, based on diagnosis codes within 60 days, and does not exclude prior bradycardia or adjust for indication, inpatient use, comorbidities, co-medications, or surveillance intensity.
